messages:
marta: Heads up — after last night's cilium patch rollout to eu-west2 we started seeing RDMA handshakes fail intermittently on GPU nodepool-3, lots of east-west packet retransmits.

anil: saw the alerts, tcp_retransmit spikes around 20:12 UTC, pods staging-*/model-worker experiencing 500ms+ tail latency.

zoe: stack traces from one pod show repeated ib_cm_id_create failures, kernel logs have 'ib_cm: path not found' then NIC linkflap entries on eth1. sharing logs:```dmesg | tail -n 50```

marta: yeah, infra metrics show per-pod loss up to 3% and p95 latency doubled. Not full outage but SLOs violated for batch infer.

infra-oncall-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-402 — RDMA handshake failures after Cilium patch in eu-west2, notified oncall.

anil: rolled back cilium-daemonset on a canary rack (nodepool-3a) at 20:30 and saw RDMA handshakes recover within ~2 mins. Can we confirm correlation?

zoe: confirmed on one node: pre-rollback: `ethtool -S eth1|grep tx_` showing drops, post-rollback metrics cleared. Also saw GSO/TSO stats jump when patched.

marta: interesting — the patch toggled GENEVE offload flags for tunnel endpoints as part of bpf/xdp egress path. Could be an offload vs SR-IOV interaction.

anil: reproducer idea: schedule two perf jobs on same host -> run rdma_cm_connect loop, measure rst/retransmits. I can try in staging-2 now.

taylor: FYI calico nodes in other regions unaffected, so seems Cilium-specific config change. Also noticed conntrack table entries for RDMA-related flows lingering.

marta: good catch on conntrack — cilium's host firewall change probably started tracking encapsulated flows, increasing CPU on kube-proxy and delaying packets.

zoe: for mitigation I suggest: 1) pin cilium to previous image for eu-west2 GPU pools 2) disable the new offload flag in CiliumConfig 3) run a gradual rollout with probe that checks `ibv_rc_pingpong` success.

anil: pinned DS back on all nodepool-3 nodes at 20:42, infra-oncall: please monitor RDMA errors and batch SLOs for 30m.

infra-oncall-bot: Rollback executed by anil at 20:42 UTC. Auto-monitoring enabled for 30m.

marta: after rollback p95 latency back to normal and retransmits dropped to baseline. We'll open a ticket with Cilium upstream to share kernel offload counter diffs and SR-IOV repro steps.

zoe: adding logs and `ethtool -k` snapshots to the ticket. Also let’s add a pre-rollout probe for RDMA path on GPU pools in our runbook.

taylor: +1 on probe and add canary gate to the deploy pipeline that runs a short rdma pingpair between two pods before proceeding cluster-wide.

marta: created ENGIN-1292 with repro, logs, and suggested probe. Assigning to eng-ml-networking. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

anil: closing thread once we confirm 1h stability — leaving monitoring on.

zoe: will follow up with upstream PR references and kernel repro notes tomorrow.
